title: Skip empty chunks in streaming mode
body:
In `BaseOpenAIChatCompletionClient.create_stream`, skip empty chunks when encountered rather than throwing errors.

Remove `max_consecutive_empty_chunk_tolerance` from create_stream method.

linked_prs.title: fix: warn on empty chunks, don't error out

## Why are these changes needed?

<!-- Please give a short summary of the change and the problem this solves. -->

We are seeing this issue more often now, probably related to the load on the API servers. Hence this PR:
1. Demotes the the `max_consecutive_empty_chunk_tolerance` parameter from function to inline threshold
2. Change exception to a one time warning
